text:
Palladium Price in 2018
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2018, the LBMA palladium price rose 20.8% between 2018-01-31 ($1,051) and 2018-12-28 ($1,270). The highest sampled price was $1,270 in December and the lowest was $928 in July. The mean of these observations was $1,044. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
